title: Random matrix theory of sparse neuronal networks with heterogeneous timescales
abstract: arXiv:2512.12767v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training recurrent neuronal networks consisting of excitatory (E) and inhibitory (I) units with additive noise for working memory computation slows and diversifies inhibitory timescales, leading to improved task performance that is attributed to emergent marginally stable equilibria [PNAS 122 (2025) e2316745122]. Yet the link between trained network characteristics and their roles in shaping desirable dynamical landscapes remains unexplored. Here, we investigate the Jacobian matrices describing the dynamics near these equilibria and show that they are sparse, non-Hermitian rectangular-block matrices modified by heterogeneous synaptic decay timescales and activation-function gains. We specify a random matrix ensemble that faithfully captures the spectra of trained Jacobian matrices, arising from the inhibitory core - excitatory periphery network motif (pruned E weights, broadly distributed I weights) observed post-training. translated_title: 具有异质时间尺度的稀疏神经元网络的随机矩阵理论
translated_abstract: 通过加性噪声训练由兴奋性（E）和抑制性（I）单元组成的循环神经元网络以执行工作记忆计算，会使抑制性时间尺度变慢并多样化，从而提升任务表现，这归因于涌现出的边际稳定平衡点 [PNAS 122 (2025) e2316745122]。然而，训练后的网络特征与其在塑造理想动力学图景中所起作用之间的联系仍未被探索。在本研究中，我们考察了描述这些平衡点附近动力学的雅可比矩阵，并表明它们是稀疏的、非厄米的矩形块矩阵，且被异质的突触衰减时间尺度和激活函数增益所修饰。我们构造了一个随机矩阵系综，能够忠实地刻画训练后雅可比矩阵的谱，这些谱源于训练后观察到的“抑制性核心—兴奋性外围”网络模体（兴奋性权重被修剪，抑制性权重广泛分布）。
tldr: 本文构造了一个能够忠实刻画具有异质抑制性时间尺度的稀疏神经元网络雅可比矩阵谱的随机矩阵系综，从而揭示了训练后网络特征（抑制核心—兴奋外围结构）与边际稳定平衡点涌现之间的内在联系。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a random matrix ensemble that faithfully captures the spectra of trained Jacobian matrices in sparse neuronal networks with heterogeneous inhibitory timescales, establishing the link between the post-training inhibitory core–excitatory periphery motif and the emergence of marginally stable dynamical landscapes.
